function.name: getAnimeSearch
function.description:
Anime search

Searches the anime catalog. Accepts filters such as q, type, score, status, rating, genres, order_by, and sort, with pagination via page.

min_score.description: Set a minimum score for results.

max_score.description: Set a maximum score for results

genres.description: Filter by genre(s) IDs. Can pass multiple with a comma as a delimiter. e.g 1,2,3

genres_exclude.description: Exclude genre(s) IDs. Can pass multiple with a comma as a delimiter. e.g 1,2,3

letter.description: Return entries starting with the given letter

producers.description: Filter by producer(s) IDs. Can pass multiple with a comma as a delimiter. e.g 1,2,3

start_date.description: Filter by starting date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. e.g `2022`, `2005-05`, `2005-01-01`

end_date.description: Filter by ending date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. e.g `2022`, `2005-05`, `2005-01-01`

function.name: getSchedules
function.description:
Anime schedule

Returns the weekly airing schedule of anime. Use filter to select a weekday, with kids and sfw to include or exclude entries by their ratings, and pagination via page.

kids.description: When supplied, it will filter entries with the `Kids` Genre Demographic. When supplied as `kids=true`, it will return only Kid entries and when supplied as `kids=false`, it will filter out any Kid entries. Defaults to `false`.

sfw.description: 'Safe For Work'. When supplied, it will filter entries with the `Hentai` Genre. When supplied as `sfw=true`, it will return only SFW entries and when supplied as `sfw=false`, it will filter out any Hentai entries. Defaults to `false`.

Returns the anime currently airing this season. Can be filtered by filter and supports pagination via page.

functions.name: getSeasonUpcoming
functions.description:
Upcoming anime season

Returns the anime of the upcoming season. Can be filtered by filter and supports pagination via page.

functions.name: getSeason
functions.description:
Seasonal anime

Returns the anime that aired in a specific year and season. Can be filtered by filter and supports pagination via page.

functions.name: getTopAnime
functions.description:
Top anime

Returns the top-ranked anime. Can be filtered by type, filter, rating, and sfw.

functions.name: getTopCharacters
functions.description:
Top characters

Returns the top-ranked characters.

functions.name: getTopManga
functions.description:
Top manga

Returns the top-ranked manga. Can be filtered by type and filter.

functions.name: getTopPeople
functions.description:
Top people

Returns the top-ranked people.

functions.name: getTopReviews
functions.description:
Top reviews

Returns the top-ranked reviews. Can be filtered by type, with preliminary and spoilers toggles.

preliminary.description: Whether the results include preliminary reviews or not. Defaults to true.

spoilers.description: Whether the results include reviews with spoilers or not. Defaults to true.

functions.name: getUsersSearch
functions.description:
Users search

Searches the users catalog using the q, gender, location, maxAge, and minAge filters. Supports pagination via page.

functions.name: getRecentlyOnlineUsers
functions.description:
Recently online users

Returns the users currently online or recently online.

functions.name: getUserById
functions.description:
User by ID

Returns a user profile by their MyAnimeList id.

functions.name: getUserProfile
functions.description:
User profile

Returns the public profile of a user by username.

functions.name: getUserAbout
functions.description:
User about

Returns the profile "about" section of a user by username in raw HTML.

functions.name: getUserAnimelist
functions.description:
User animelist

Returns the anime list of a user by username, optionally filtered by status. Note: MyAnimeList discontinued user lists on May 1st, 2022.

functions.name: getUserClubs
functions.description:
User clubs

Returns the clubs joined by a user by username, paginated by page.

functions.name: getUserExternal
functions.description:
User external links

Returns the external links of a user by username.

functions.name: getUserFavorites
functions.description:
User favorites

Returns the favorites of a user by username.

functions.name: getUserFriends
functions.description:
User friends

Returns the friends of a user by username, paginated by page.

functions.name: getUserFullProfile
functions.description:
Complete user profile

Returns the complete profile of a user by username.

functions.name: getUserHistory
functions.description:
User history

Returns the recent anime and manga history of a user by username. Use type to filter to anime or manga entries.

functions.name: getUserMangaList
functions.description:
User manga list

Returns the manga list of a user by username, optionally filtered by status. Note: MyAnimeList discontinued user lists on May 1st, 2022.

functions.name: getUserRecommendations
functions.description:
User recommendations

Returns the recommendations made by a user by username, paginated by page.

functions.name: getUserReviews
functions.description:
User reviews

Returns the reviews written by a user by username, paginated by page.

functions.name: getUserStatistics
functions.description:
User statistics

Returns the statistics of a user by username.

functions.name: getUserUpdates
functions.description:
User updates

Returns the recent anime and manga list updates of a user by username.

functions.name: getWatchRecentEpisodes
functions.description:
Recently added episodes

Returns recently added episodes currently trending on MyAnimeList.

functions.name: getWatchPopularEpisodes
functions.description:
Popular episodes

Returns popular episodes currently trending on MyAnimeList.

functions.name: getWatchRecentPromos
functions.description:
Recently added promotional videos

Returns recently added promotional videos currently trending on MyAnimeList.

functions.name: getWatchPopularPromos
functions.description:
Popular promotional videos

Returns popular promotional videos currently trending on MyAnimeList.
